items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: So Lorraine come down and they told me about it.

ctx.x: And he was a popular man. Everybody liked him. He was a well-liked man.

Oh, everybody. White and colored. Everybody. White and colored. Everybody. He had a funeral. It was long, it was from where I'm sitting, almost to Espinay Street. Yes. But the rain came out and there was, the people was willing to walk with the bands. He had seven bands volunteered behind. Where did the funeral start? Where it started at? It started from Sinan and Derry. I had them laid out by his sister, by his niece's house. My name was Lena Polder. And the funeral started from there, from the house. You know,…
And this is two, if you know, and love.
